blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Students from seven educational institutions in Baguio City and Benguet staged a mass walkout on Friday, Nov. 13, to protest against Pax Silica ahead of U.S. President Donald Trump’s visit to the Philippines. Organizers described the activity as peaceful. Participants from the University of the Philippines Baguio, University of the Cordilleras, Saint Louis University, University of Baguio, Benguet State University, Easter College and Baguio City National Science High School left their classrooms and marched from their respective campuses through the city before converging at Igorot Park.
